note: Festival dates follow the Tamil calendar and move each year. Months are approximate; confirm dates with the temple before you travel.

seasons.name: Summer
seasons.weather: Hot days (often 35–40 °C). Go early morning and after sunset.

festivals.name: Panguni Brahmotsavam
festivals.text: The temple's great festival, celebrating Murugan's wedding to Deivanai here.

festivals.name: Chithirai Thiruvizha
festivals.text: Madurai's biggest festival: Meenakshi's celestial wedding, the temple chariots and the city's busiest days of the year.

festivals.name: Kallazhagar enters the Vaigai
festivals.text: Alagar travels from his hill temple to Madurai. Ethir Sevai welcomes him; he enters the Vaigai on the full moon.

festivals.name: Vaikasi Visakam
festivals.text: Murugan's birth star, celebrated at his first abode.

seasons.name: Light monsoon
seasons.weather: Madurai gets little of the south-west monsoon: warm, breezy, occasional showers.

festivals.name: Aadi Brahmotsavam and car festival
festivals.text: Ten days of festival at the hill temple; the great chariot is pulled on the Aadi full moon.

festivals.name: Unity feast
festivals.text: Every Independence Day, thousands sit together for a communal meal at Pandi Muneeswarar's temple.

festivals.name: Avani Moola festival
festivals.text: Processions on the Avani Moola streets retell Shiva's sacred plays in Madurai.

seasons.name: Festive rains
seasons.weather: The north-east monsoon brings Madurai's real rain. Green and cooler; carry an umbrella.

festivals.name: Navaratri
festivals.text: Nine nights; the goddess wears a different form each evening and homes set out golu dolls.

festivals.name: Kanda Sashti
festivals.text: Murugan's victory over Surapadman, enacted on the sixth day. The biggest festival at Thiruparankundram, and celebrated at Pazhamudircholai like all six abodes.

festivals.name: Kanda Sashti at the sixth abode
festivals.text: Pilgrims climb the hill road above Alagar Kovil for the six days of Kanda Sashti.

festivals.name: Karthigai Deepam
festivals.text: Lamps everywhere, and a great lamp lit on the hill.

festivals.name: Vaikunta Ekadasi
festivals.text: One of Alagar's most important days, with crowds through the night.

seasons.name: Winter
seasons.weather: The best weather of the year: clear, mild days and cool mornings.

festivals.name: Pongal and jallikattu
festivals.text: The harvest festival. Madurai's famous bull-taming events run on consecutive days in three villages.

festivals.name: Teppa Thiruvizha (float festival)
festivals.text: Meenakshi and Sundareswarar float on a lit raft across the great tank.

festivals.name: Float festival
festivals.text: Murugan's own float festival at the foot of the hill.

festivals.name: Masi float festival
festivals.text: One of Alagar Kovil's most prominent festivals.
